Currently all squares are g. The cross positions are: (49,29), (54,24), (54,34), (59,29).
Let me click just these 4 cross positions and see if the level completes.
But wait, I already tried this earlier and the blocks moved but the level didn't complete.
Hmm, let me try clicking the CENTER square only. The center is at (54,29). In the initial state, it was g (not part of the cross). Maybe clicking it does something special.
Actually, I just realized: the initial squares have a checkerboard pattern. The cross positions are W, and the non-cross positions are g. The center is g. The purple dots form a cross. So the squares' W positions match the purple dot positions.
Maybe the goal is to make ALL squares the same color as the purple dots (P/purple)? Or maybe the goal is to make the cross-position squares purple?
Let me try clicking the center square and see what happens.
